# 涡轮与冷却

_Turbines & Cooling_

涡轮从高温燃气中提取功率，驱动压气机或输出轴。涡轮气动、冷却气消耗、叶片温度和材料能力共同影响性能与寿命。

_Turbines extract power from hot gas to drive compressors or deliver shaft output. Aerodynamics, cooling-air consumption, blade temperature and material capability jointly influence performance and life._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 从级的功率交换入手，理解速度三角形和反动度等概念。

_Start with stage work and velocity triangles, then examine concepts such as degree of reaction._

- 区分内部冷却、气膜冷却等思路，阅读时同时关注热防护效果与流动损失。

_Distinguish internal cooling from film cooling and consider both thermal protection and aerodynamic losses._

- 把金属温度、热应力和冷却用气放回整机循环中考察。

_Assess metal temperature, thermal stress and cooling-air demand within the overall cycle._
